tooltips.add_file_or_folder: Accepts PDF files, image folders, or image ZIPs.
tooltips.output_format: Choose PDF, or DJVU via native Rust encoding
tooltips.base_format: 1bit encoding - JBIG2 has better compression and dithering while CCITT4 has wider compatibility
tooltips.image_output_type: Original color with CCITT4 encoding, or dithered with JBIG2 encoding
tooltips.layout_detection: Enable when your document has complex image areas, GPU accelerated layout detection will preserve them from binarization.
tooltips.heavy_model: Heavy Sauvola AI model (ONNX) for degraded pages. benefits from layout detection.
tooltips.inverted_colors: for digitally created documents with dark background and light text. Will convert to white blackground, black text
tooltips.ocr_text_layer: this adds an optical character recognition layer (HOCR) to each page
tooltips.high_quality_output: Use higher-quality image encoding. PDF uses JPEG quality 95; DJVU uses the highest IW44 setting when enabled. Keep unchecked for outputs intended for e-ink readers.
tooltips.cover_format_no_cover: treat first page same as others; image format affects all non-binarized images
tooltips.cover_format_dithered: CCITT4 text with blue-noise dithered image regions where enabled (global)
tooltips.target_height: Select a preset or use proportional scaling
tooltips.sauvola_window_size: Local analysis window size - larger: smoother, smaller: more detail-sensitive
tooltips.sauvola_k_factor: Contrast sensitivity - lower: more text preserved, higher: cleaner backgrounds. benefits from layout detection.
tooltips.sauvola_r: Variance scaling - lower: less aggressive, higher: stronger adaptation to noise
tooltips.threshold_value: Fixed threshold value (0-255) applied after linearization.
tooltips.margin_centering: Centers content area on specified page output dimensions
tooltips.margin_crop_resize: Crop margins to content bounds and resizes to specified output dimensions
tooltips.deskew_documents: Detect rotation and unwarp page by page before further processing

status.processing_failed: Processing failed - check error details above

messages.settings_and_queue_reset: Settings and queue reset ({} files cleared)
messages.defaulted_output_dir: output directory defaulted to input file directory

install_help.openvino_linux: For best performance on Linux, install or enable OpenVINO
install_help.directml_windows: For best performance on Windows, install DirectML and recent GPU drivers
